steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. The mandate needs a success measure with a target, and each fee term needs a source.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Success measure with no target
findings.fix: Set the target the search is judged on

findings.title: Fee term with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the fee term

outcome.notChecked: Whether the role is right for the client.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] mandate-success.md:12  Success measure with no target.
       Fix: Set the target the search is judged on.
[medium] mandate-timeline.md:19  Fee term with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the fee term.
[low] terms.md:26  Timeline with no milestone.
       Fix: Add the milestone.
Not checked: Whether the role is right for the client.
pros: Checks a success measure with no target, and a fee term with no source.
cons: Not checked: Whether the role is right for the client.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-search-mandate skill on the records for this review.
